author: Juanooo
body:
I'm completely done with him being a dick. Have lost like a million brain cells due to him attempting to be toxic but's time for me to report him.

Shouldn't he be banned for excessive infractions already? He has gotten more than 10 in the past 8 months plus he's DDoSed me, ban evaded and hacked twice before as well as publicly posting pics of me irl on Twitter (I didn't know about this till yesterday night when Felipu told me). I'm quite concerned about all those reasons but specially for the one where he harrasses me. I don't get how he's still here. I'm aware most of you guys think the same as me and that's why I wanted to point this out.

Thanks, and I'll be waiting for your answer.
